items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Happy Days는 Tom과 그의 개 Max의 우정에 관한 영화이다.
이 영화는 두 사람 사이의 사랑 이야기이다.
영화 제작에는 소수의 사람들만 참여하고 있다.
items.exp: It's a movie about the friendship between Tom and his dog Max.에서 확인할 수 있어요. Jim Brown은 감독이고, 많은 사람들이 영화를 만들고 있어요.
items.passage: Hi, I'm Jim Brown, the director of Happy Days. It's a movie about the friendship between Tom and his dog Max. A lot of people are working hard to create this movie. Do you want to meet some of them?

items.q: 밑줄 친 are working과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: They are going to play soccer.
My dad is cooking dinner now.
items.exp: are working은 'be동사 + 동사원형-ing'인 현재진행형이에요. 'be going to'는 예정, interested는 형용사예요.
items.passage: A lot of people [are working] hard to create this movie.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: He drinks a lot of waters.
She has a lot of friend.
There is a lot of books on the desk.
A lot of people is waiting outside.
We need a lot of time.
items.exp: a lot of 뒤에는 셀 수 있는 명사의 복수형과 셀 수 없는 명사가 모두 올 수 있어요. 주어가 a lot of people이면 복수 취급해서 are를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것은?
choices: 영화를 만들기 위해 열심히 일하고 있는 많은 사람들
items.exp: 앞 문장의 A lot of people (who are) working hard to create this movie를 가리켜요.
items.passage: Do you want to meet [some of them]?

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분처럼 앞의 명사를 설명하는 동격 표현이 쓰인 문장은?
choices: Mr. Kim is my English teacher.
Mr. Kim is a teacher and a writer.
I met Mr. Kim and my English teacher.
I saw Mr. Kim's English teacher.
I met Mr. Kim, my English teacher.
items.exp: Jim Brown과 the director of Happy Days는 같은 사람이에요. Mr. Kim, my English teacher도 같은 사람을 가리키는 동격이에요.
items.passage: Hi, I'm Jim Brown, [the director of Happy Days].

items.q: 밑줄 친 to find와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: He studied hard to pass the exam.
My dream is to be a pilot.
She was happy to see her friend.
I have no time to play.
I went to the shop to buy milk.
items.exp: my job is to find ~의 to부정사는 보어로 쓰인 명사적 용법이에요. My dream is to be a pilot도 같은 쓰임이에요.
items.passage: I'm a location manager, and my job [is to find] perfect places for shooting.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I love to listen to music.
items.exp: like, love, hate, start, begin 뒤에는 to부정사나 동명사가 와요. to cooking처럼 to 뒤에 동명사를 쓸 수는 없어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것은?
choices: to find perfect places for shooting
items.exp: 바로 앞 문장의 my job is to find perfect places for shooting에서 to find ~가 쉽지 않다는 뜻이에요.
items.passage: Of course, [it] is not easy, but I love my job.

items.q: 다음 중 동사의 원형과 과거형이 잘못 짝지어진 것은?
items.exp: catch의 과거형은 불규칙 변화 caught예요. find–found, take–took, make–made는 모두 불규칙, train–trained는 규칙 변화예요.

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: 촬영하기 좋은 장소를 찾는 것이 직업이다.
일이 쉽지 않지만 자신의 일을 좋아한다.
items.exp: 모든 카메라를 담당하는 사람은 Peter(director of photography)예요. Anna는 location manager예요.
items.passage: I'm Anna, and I found this beautiful beach. I'm a location manager, and my job is to find perfect places for shooting. Of course, it is not easy, but I love my job. I like to travel and enjoy challenges.

items.q: 밑줄 친 in charge of와 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은?
items.exp: be in charge of ~는 '~을 담당하다, 책임지다'라는 뜻으로 be responsible for ~와 같아요.
items.passage: I'm Peter, the director of photography for this movie. I'm [in charge of] all the cameras.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: We are going to meet at noon.
He is going to see a movie with his friends.
They are going to play soccer.
She is going to visit her uncle.
I am going to studying English tonight.
items.exp: be going to 뒤에는 항상 동사원형이 와요. studying → study.

items.q: 밑줄 친 To capture와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: He has a lot of work to do.
I went to the library to borrow books.
I want to be a pilot.
My hobby is to collect stamps.
items.exp: To capture는 '~하기 위해'라는 목적을 나타내는 부사적 용법이에요. to borrow도 목적이에요.
items.passage: [To capture] their happy moments, I'm going to use drones.

items.q: 밑줄 친 their가 가리키는 것은?
items.exp: 바로 앞 문장의 Tom and Max를 가리켜요.
items.passage: To capture [their] happy moments, I'm going to use drones.

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: Peter는 오늘 Tom, Max와 함께 해변에서 공놀이를 할 것이다.
Tom과 Max는 해변에서 공을 가지고 놀 예정이다.
items.exp: 해변에서 공놀이를 할 예정인 것은 Tom과 Max이고, Peter는 그 모습을 촬영해요.
items.passage: I'm Peter, the director of photography for this movie. I'm in charge of all the cameras. Today, Tom and Max are going to play together with a ball on the beach. To capture their happy moments, I'm going to use drones.

items.q: 밑줄 친 took care of와 바꿔 쓸 수 있는 것은?
items.exp: take care of ~는 '~을 돌보다'이고 look after ~와 같아요.
items.passage: I trained and [took care of] Max for a long time.

items.q: 빈도부사의 위치가 올바른 문장은?
choices: She is usually late for class.
We have usually lunch at noon.
items.exp: 빈도부사는 be동사와 조동사 뒤, 일반동사 앞에 와요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 So가 쓰인 문장을 because를 이용해 바꾼 것으로 알맞은 것은?
choices: I use hand signals to calm Max because he is a great actor.
I use hand signals to calm Max because he sometimes gets too excited.
Max sometimes gets too excited because I use hand signals to calm him.
Because I use hand signals, Max is a great actor.
I use hand signals because Max never gets excited.
items.exp: so는 결과, because는 원인을 이끌어요. 원인은 Max가 가끔 너무 흥분하는 것이고, 결과는 수신호를 쓰는 것이에요.
items.passage: Max sometimes gets too excited. [So], I use hand signals to calm him.

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Max는 사람이 많이 있어도 항상 침착하다.
items.exp: I trained and took care of Max for a long time.에서 알 수 있어요. 직업은 animal wrangler이고, 수신호로 Max를 진정시켜요.
items.passage: I'm Jennifer. I trained and took care of Max for a long time. Max is a great actor, but he sometimes gets too excited when a lot of people are around. So, I use hand signals to calm him. Who am I? I'm an animal wrangler.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
items.exp: get + 형용사는 '~한 상태가 되다'라는 뜻이라 부사가 올 수 없어요. happily → happy.

items.q: 밑줄 친 after와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: The day after tomorrow is Friday.
Let's go home after the movie.
I'll call you after I finish dinner.
items.exp: 밑줄 친 after는 뒤에 주어와 동사(the shooting is over)가 오는 접속사예요. 나머지는 명사 앞에 쓰인 전치사예요.
items.passage: My work begins [after] the shooting is over.

items.q: 원급 – 비교급 – 최상급이 잘못 짝지어진 것은?
items.exp: famous 같은 긴 형용사는 more, most를 붙여서 more famous – most famous가 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
items.exp: 조동사 can 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요. deletes → delete.
items.passage: To create a better story, I can change the order of scenes or delete some of them.

items.q: 밑줄 친 a lot과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: There are a lot of stars.
She bought a lot of books.
A lot of kids like him.
We need a lot of water.
He talks a lot in class.
items.exp: 밑줄 친 a lot은 동사 뒤에서 '많이'를 뜻하는 부사예요. a lot of는 뒤에 명사가 오는 형용사구예요.
items.passage: Storytelling skills are important for my job, so I read [a lot].

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Emma는 장면을 삭제할 수는 없고 순서만 바꿀 수 있다.
Emma는 이야기를 만드는 능력은 중요하지 않다고 생각한다.
Emma의 일은 촬영이 끝난 후에 시작된다.
items.exp: My work begins after the shooting is over.에서 확인할 수 있어요. 장면의 순서를 바꾸거나 삭제할 수 있어요.
items.passage: My name is Emma, and I'm a film editor. My work begins after the shooting is over. To create a better story, I can change the order of scenes or delete some of them. Storytelling skills are important for my job, so I read a lot.

items.q:
윗글을 바탕으로 빈칸 (A)~(C)에 알맞은 말은?

Emma ( A ) a film editor. Her work begins ( B ) the shooting is over. She reads a lot ( C ) storytelling skills are important.
items.exp: 주어 Emma에는 is, 촬영이 끝난 '후에' 시작하므로 after예요. 이야기 기술이 중요하다는 것은 책을 많이 읽는 '이유'이므로 because예요.
items.passage: My name is Emma, and I'm a film editor. My work begins after the shooting is over. To create a better story, I can change the order of scenes or delete some of them. Storytelling skills are important for my job, so I read a lot.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
choices: Reading books are good for you.
Making sound effects is not easy.
items.exp: 동명사(구) 주어는 단수 취급하므로 is를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
items.exp: y로 끝나는 형용사는 y를 i로 고치고 -ly를 붙여서 happily가 돼요.

items.q: 'Doesn't it sound real?'에 대해 '응, 진짜처럼 들려.'라고 대답할 때 알맞은 것은?
items.exp: 부정의문문에서도 Yes/No는 대답의 내용에 따라 정해져요. 진짜처럼 들린다면 Yes, it does.예요.
items.passage: I made that sound with rice and a plastic container. Doesn't it sound real?

items.q: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: 촬영 현장에서 녹음하기 어려울 때 스튜디오에서 효과음을 만든다.
촬영이 끝난 뒤 장면 순서를 바꾼다.
items.exp: I create sound effects in my studio when recording on location is not easy.에서 알 수 있어요. 파도 소리는 쌀과 플라스틱 용기로 만들었어요.
items.passage: I'm Chris, and I'm a Foley artist. I create sound effects in my studio when recording on location is not easy. Listen carefully. Do you hear the sound of waves? I made that sound with rice and a plastic container. Doesn't it sound real?

items.q: 본문에 나온 인물과 직업이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
items.exp: Anna는 location manager, Peter는 director of photography, Emma는 film editor, Chris는 Foley artist예요.

items.q: 빈칸에 들어갈 전치사가 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: Jim is the tallest ____ my three friends.
It is the biggest city ____ the world.
She is the smartest student ____ our school.
Seoul is the largest city ____ Korea.
He is the fastest runner ____ Korea.
items.exp: 장소나 범위를 나타내는 말 앞에서는 최상급 뒤에 in을 쓰고, 비교 대상이 복수일 때는 of를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 like와 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: He can swim like a fish.
I'd like to be a pilot.
items.exp: 밑줄 친 like는 '~처럼'이라는 전치사예요. 나머지는 '좋아하다'라는 동사예요.
items.passage: I will practice hard every day to become a great soccer player [like] him.

items.q: 윗글에서 To become a good soccer player, he practiced 10 hours every day.와 의미가 같은 것은?
choices: He practiced 10 hours every day because he did not want to be a player.
He became a good soccer player, so he practiced 10 hours every day.
He wanted to become a good soccer player, so he practiced 10 hours every day.
He practiced 10 hours every day, but he did not want to be a good player.
He is a good soccer player because he did not practice.
items.exp: To become ~는 '~이 되기 위해'라는 목적이에요. 좋은 선수가 되고 싶어서 연습했다는 뜻이에요.
items.passage: I want to be a soccer player in the future, and my role model is Metti. He is the best soccer player in the world. To become a good soccer player, he practiced 10 hours every day. I will practice hard every day to become a great soccer player like him.

items.q:
윗글을 바탕으로 빈칸 (A), (B)에 알맞은 말은?

Metti ( A ) 10 hours every day, and the writer ( B ) hard every day.
items.exp: Metti는 과거에 연습했고(practiced), 글쓴이는 앞으로 연습할 것이라고(will practice) 했어요.
items.passage: I want to be a soccer player in the future, and my role model is Metti. He is the best soccer player in the world. To become a good soccer player, he practiced 10 hours every day. I will practice hard every day to become a great soccer player like him.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: A space tour guide guides people into space and give them information about space.
A 3D printer helps a chef make food in different designs.
A flying taxi-pilot carries people around cities to save time.
A chef uses a 3D printer to make food in many colors.
A flying taxi-pilot flies an aircraft and carries people.
items.exp: and로 연결된 두 동사는 형태를 일치시켜야 해요. guides와 연결된 동사도 3인칭 단수 현재형 gives예요.
items.passage:
A 3D-printing chef uses a 3D printer to make food in different colors and designs.
A flying taxi-pilot flies an aircraft and carries people around cities.

items.q:
빈칸 (A)~(C)에 알맞은 전치사를 순서대로 쓴 것은?

(A) A guide gives information ( A ) them.
(B) Mom makes dinner ( B ) us.
(C) He sends a letter ( C ) her.
items.exp: give, send는 전치사 to, make는 전치사 for를 써서 3형식으로 바꿔요.
items.passage: A space tour guide guides people into space and [gives them information] about space.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: One of the tallest buildings is here.
One of my classmates is a pilot.
One of her dreams is to travel.
One of the best movie is Happy Days.
One of the most interesting jobs will be a chef.
items.exp: one of 뒤에는 복수 명사가 와요. movie → movies. 주어가 one이므로 동사는 단수 is예요.
items.passage: One of the most interesting jobs in the future will be a 3D-printing chef.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?

(a) Many people is working hard to create this movie.
(b) I like to travel and enjoy challenges.
(c) Max sometimes gets too excited.
(d) I am going to using drones.
(e) Listen careful.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: Many people에는 are. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: going to 뒤에는 동사원형. (e) 틀림: 동사를 꾸미므로 carefully. 따라서 옳은 문장은 (b), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
자연스러운 글이 되도록 (A)~(C)를 바르게 배열한 것은?

(A) So, I use hand signals to calm him.
(B) Max is a great actor, but he sometimes gets too excited when a lot of people are around.
(C) I trained and took care of Max for a long time.
items.exp: Max를 처음 소개하는 (C) → Max가 흥분한다는 (B) → 그래서 수신호를 쓴다는 (A) 순서예요. (A)의 him은 (B)의 Max를 가리켜요.
items.passage: I'm Jennifer.

items.q:
주어진 문장이 들어갈 위치로 가장 알맞은 곳은?

To capture their happy moments, I'm going to use drones.
items.exp: their happy moments의 their가 Tom and Max를 가리키므로 그들이 소개된 문장 뒤인 ③에 들어가야 해요.
items.passage: I'm Peter, the director of photography for this movie. (①) I'm in charge of all the cameras. (②) Today, Tom and Max are going to play together with a ball on the beach. (③) I'm Jennifer. (④) I trained and took care of Max for a long time. (⑤)

items.q: 다음 글쓴이에게 해당하는 직업은?
items.exp: 현장 녹음이 어려울 때 스튜디오에서 일하며 소리를 만드는 사람은 Foley artist예요. location이 나온다고 location manager는 아니에요.
items.passage: I work in a studio when recording on location is not easy.

items.q: 교과서에 나온 빈도부사를 빈도가 높은 것부터 낮은 것 순서로 바르게 나열한 것은?
items.exp: 교과서에는 always(항상) > usually(보통) > often(자주) > sometimes(때때로) > hardly(거의 ~않는) 순서로 나와요.

items.q:
( ) 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

(A) She sings (beautiful / beautifully).
(B) He runs (fast / fastly).
(C) The room is (quiet / quietly).
items.exp: (A) 동사를 꾸미므로 부사 beautifully. (B) fast는 형용사·부사 형태가 같아요. (C) be동사 뒤 보어는 형용사 quiet이에요.

items.q: What is Peter going to use to capture Tom and Max's happy moments?
items.exp: To capture their happy moments, I'm going to use drones.에서 확인할 수 있어요.
items.passage: I'm Peter, the director of photography for this movie. I'm in charge of all the cameras. Today, Tom and Max are going to play together with a ball on the beach. To capture their happy moments, I'm going to use drones.

items.q: Why does Jennifer use hand signals?
choices: To tell Tom where to stand.
To make the sound of waves.
To calm Max when he gets too excited.
To keep drones away from Max.
items.exp: Max가 사람이 많을 때 너무 흥분하기 때문에 그를 진정시키려고(to calm him) 수신호를 써요.
items.passage: I'm Jennifer. I trained and took care of Max for a long time. Max is a great actor, but he sometimes gets too excited when a lot of people are around. So, I use hand signals to calm him. Who am I? I'm an animal wrangler.

items.q: What did Chris use to make the sound of waves?
items.exp: I made that sound with rice and a plastic container.에서 확인할 수 있어요.
items.passage: I'm Chris, and I'm a Foley artist. I create sound effects in my studio when recording on location is not easy. Listen carefully. Do you hear the sound of waves? I made that sound with rice and a plastic container. Doesn't it sound real?

items.q: 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것은?
items.exp: delete some of them은 '장면들 중 일부를 삭제하다'라는 뜻이라서 them은 scenes를 가리켜요.
items.passage: To create a better story, I can change the order of scenes or delete some of [them].

items.q: 밑줄 친 calm과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?
items.exp: 흥분한 Max를 진정시키는 것이므로 calm은 '진정시키다'라는 뜻이에요.
items.passage: Max is a great actor, but he sometimes gets too excited when a lot of people are around. So, I use hand signals to [calm] him.

items.q:
